ShippingDate.name: Shipping Date
ShippingDate.definition: Shipping date of the product or the date services rendered.

MedicalServices.name: Medical Services
MedicalServices.definition: Indicates whether or not the invoice line item represents a medical service.

ShipToIndustryCode.name: Ship To Industry Code
ShipToIndustryCode.definition: Contains the health industry number to which the medical services are being shipped (for example, Medical Services ship to Health Industry Number).

ProductQualifier.name: Product Qualifier
ProductQualifier.definition: Contains a code that identifies the product number qualifier of the product (for example, medical services).

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: May contain further clarifying data, such as event name, etc.

TypeOfSupply.name: Type Of Supply
TypeOfSupply.definition: Indicates whether the purchase is categorized|as goods or services.

UnitOfMeasure.name: Unit Of Measure
UnitOfMeasure.definition: Unit of measure of the item purchased.

UnitPrice.name: Unit Price
UnitPrice.definition: Contains the price for one unit of the product or service.

AdjustmentAmount.name: Adjustment Amount
AdjustmentAmount.definition: Contains the adjusted amount (for example, discounts).

AdjustmentCreditDebit.name: Adjustment Credit Debit
AdjustmentCreditDebit.definition: A code to indicate the adjustment amount is credit or debit

Insurance.name: Insurance
Insurance.definition: Indicates whether or not insurance was purchased.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Taxes related to the products or services.

VATInvoiceReference.name: VAT Invoice Reference
VATInvoiceReference.definition: Identifies the value-added tax (VAT) invoice or tax receipt.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Total amount of line item, inclusive of any applicable adjustments and taxes.

CreditDebit.name: Credit Debit
CreditDebit.definition: A code to indicate the tax amount is credit or debit

ZeroCostToCustomer.name: Zero Cost To Customer
ZeroCostToCustomer.definition: Indicates whether or not the line item carries a cost. ||True : Line item does not have any cost associated to the customer.|False : Line item has cost associated to the customer.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
